verdict.rationale: AIMA is a government immigration-agency web service, and such services can plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so the axis applies. The only evidence is a probe whose TLS connection to aima.gov.pt failed before anything was fetched, so there is no evidence of an OpenAPI or equivalent spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
